pattern: SELECT (.*) FROM \(\( SELECT model, COUNT\(DISTINCT make\) as num\_makes FROM car\_names GROUP BY model \) AS model\_count ORDER BY num\_makes DESC LIMIT 1
correction: SELECT Model FROM CAR_NAMES GROUP BY Model ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

metadata.description: This rule corrects queries that incorrectly aggregate by a column other than the one intended, in this case, aggregating by 'make' instead of 'model'.
